visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, parted hair wearing a grey button-up shirt over a white t-shirt speaks directly into a handheld camera in a selfie perspective. Beside him is a woman with long brown hair wearing a grey t-shirt. They are standing in a bright retail environment with shelves of home goods and pillows in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman looking upward and smiling broadly. The background shows organized metal shelving stocked with white and light blue bed linens. The lighting is clean and bright, characteristic of a studio or retail store. (3) Back to a medium shot, the man and woman interact playfully. Pink flower-shaped graphics occasionally float around the man's head. The man gestures with his hands while speaking, and white Traditional Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) A static shot displays a promotional poster titled 'HOLA 大人の寢' featuring a person sleeping under grey sheets. This is followed by a montage of close-up shots showing various bed linens in pastel pink, grey, and floral patterns neatly packaged on store shelves. (5) The scene shifts to a bedroom showroom where the man lies down on a bed with a grey and floral duvet. The woman stands over him. Later, he jumps onto the bed energetically. A large translucent brown graphic overlay appears on the screen, detailing promotional prices and discount codes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Storytelling -> Product Demonstration -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a commercial promotion for HOLA Tencel bedding. It uses a comedic hook where an influencer playfully suggests he is introducing a romantic partner to his mother, only to reveal that the 'partner' is high-quality bedding. It then details the product's benefits and highlights a limited-time discount and coupon offer to drive sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product logo, detailed explanation of product materials (Tencel), and specific discount codes for HOLA stores.
